hidden_test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_repopilot_sqlparse_004.py b/tests/test_repopilot_sqlparse_004.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b098fbb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_repopilot_sqlparse_004.py
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import sqlparse
+
+
+PROCEDURE = (
+    "CREATE PROCEDURE countdown(IN n INT)\n"
+    "BEGIN\n"
+    "  WHILE n > 0 DO\n"
+    "    SET n = n - 1;\n"
+    "  END WHILE;\n"
+    "END;"
+)
+
+
+def test_split_after_a_procedure_with_a_while_loop():
+    statements = sqlparse.split(PROCEDURE + "\nSELECT 1;\nSELECT 2;")
+    assert len(statements) == 3
+    assert statements[0] == PROCEDURE
+    assert statements[1:] == ["SELECT 1;", "SELECT 2;"]
+
+
+def test_split_two_procedures_with_while_loops():
+    statements = sqlparse.split(PROCEDURE + "\n" + PROCEDURE)
+    assert statements == [PROCEDURE, PROCEDURE]
+
+
+def test_split_while_loop_nested_in_an_if_block():
+    procedure = (
+        "CREATE PROCEDURE p()\n"
+        "BEGIN\n"
+        "  IF x THEN\n"
+        "    WHILE y DO SET y = y - 1; END WHILE;\n"
+        "  END IF;\n"
+        "END;"
+    )
+    assert sqlparse.split(procedure + "\nSELECT 1;") == [procedure, "SELECT 1;"]
